params.name: opts
params.type: { type: string, count?: number, dryRun?: boolean }
params.doc: type: a die name ("d6", "d20", "d100"); count: 1..30, default 1; dryRun: only say what would spawn

methods.returns: { ok, requested, spawned, stopped } | { ok: false, code, reason }
sideEffects: Dice So Nice persistent dice (its own user flags, broadcast to every client)
methods.doc: Spawn count persistent dice of one type for the calling user, through Dice So Nice's own persistent.spawn (so they sync and are saved). A d100 spawns as its linked pair. Stops at Dice So Nice's dice cap.

params.name: opts
params.doc: type: only dice of this type (a d100 pair counts as a d100)

methods.doc: Add the calling user's persistent dice (all, or one type) to Dice So Nice's selection on this client and redraw the outlines. Returns how many dice are selected now.
Clear Dice So Nice's persistent-dice selection on this client. Returns how many were selected.

methods.returns: { enabled, dsnActive, persistentDice, mine, selected, shortcut, internals }
methods.doc: Read-only diagnosis: the setting, whether Dice So Nice and its persistent dice are on, how many dice this user has, the selection by type, the shortcut's label and the internals check.
Check that the six Dice So Nice internals this module uses still exist (run after a Dice So Nice update). Needs Dice So Nice's persistent dice setting on.

settings.doc: Per browser: the count boxes, the select buttons and the hint line in Dice So Nice's sidebar tab, and the select-all shortcut. Read live; the tab redraws on change, so no reload.
